skill.name: lark-im
skill.description: Use Lark IM with lark-cli to send messages, search chat history, manage group chats, download message resources, and handle reactions.
skill.summary: Guides AI tools through Lark IM messaging, search, group management, resource downloads, and reactions.
skill.author: larksuite

content.value_statement: Lark users need safe help with chat searches, message replies, and group management. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through approved lark-cli IM workflows.
actual_capabilities: Send Lark messages and replies as a bot using text, Markdown, exact payloads, or media attachments.
Search visible Lark chats and messages by keyword, sender, chat, attachment type, and time range.
List chat messages and thread replies with pagination, sender details, message IDs, and resource markers.
Create and update group chats with documented identity, owner, member, and dry-run options.
Download approved image and file resources from messages to safe relative output paths.
Read and manage message reactions through documented Lark IM reaction APIs.
limitations: Requires lark-cli and valid Lark user or bot authentication with the needed scopes.
Search and listing only return chats and messages visible to the selected identity.
Sending messages and replies requires explicit user approval before execution.
Markdown mode is converted to Lark post format and may normalize headings, spacing, and images.

use_cases.title: Find Team Context
use_cases.description: Search recent Lark messages, inspect threads, and summarize decisions from visible project chats.

use_cases.title: Send Approved Updates
use_cases.description: Prepare and send confirmed status updates, replies, and media messages through the app bot.

use_cases.title: Manage Group Operations
use_cases.description: Create groups, update chat metadata, locate chat IDs, and handle message resources during support work.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Chat
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the Lark group named Design Review. Show me the most likely chat ID and the visible chat details.

prompt_templates.title: Send an Approved Message
prompt_templates.prompt: Send this exact message to the Engineering Updates chat after confirming the recipient and content with me: The build is green.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Project Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Project Alpha messages from this week, include thread replies when available, and summarize decisions, blockers, and owners.

prompt_templates.title: Collect Approved Resources
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for file messages in Legal Review from last month, list the resource keys, and download only the files I approve to relative paths.

output_examples.input: Search the project chat for this week's release discussions.
output_examples.output: Found relevant messages across several threads. The summary highlights release owner, blocker status, test progress, and unresolved decisions.

output_examples.input: Reply to this message with a short status update.
output_examples.output: Prepared a plain text reply, confirmed the target message and content, then sent it as the app bot with duplicate-send protection.

output_examples.input: Download the image from this message.
output_examples.output: Identified the image resource key, confirmed the message and filename, and saved the approved image to a relative output path.

best_practices: Confirm the recipient, message content, and sending identity before every send or reply action.
Use chat IDs, sender filters, and time ranges to keep searches focused and relevant.
Use dry-run or preview options before visible chat changes when the workflow supports them.
anti_patterns: Sending or replying to Lark messages without explicit user approval.
Running broad message searches without filters, time ranges, or pagination limits.
Assuming Markdown output is exact when the skill documents Lark-specific conversion behavior.

faq.question: Does this skill send messages automatically?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow requires confirmation of recipient, content, and identity before sending or replying.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when lark-cli is available.

faq.question: Can it work with direct messages?
faq.answer: Yes. It can resolve direct-message conversations from a user open ID when permissions allow access.

faq.question: Can it download attachments from chats?
faq.answer: Yes. It can download approved image and file resources using message IDs, resource keys, and relative output paths.

faq.question: What permissions are required?
faq.answer: Permissions depend on the workflow. Lark scopes such as chat read, message read, message send, and resource access may be required.

faq.question: Can it search all company messages?
faq.answer: No. Searches are limited to messages visible to the authorized user or bot and the granted Lark scopes.
